blogs/blogs.html.title: Blogs
blogs/blogs.html.body:
Blogs
A blog in Shopify allows you to share news, updates, guides, and engaging content to attract visitors, boost SEO, and enhance customer engagement.


Step 1: Navigate to Blog Posts

Go to Shopify Admin > Online Store > Blog Posts.
Click Create Blog Post.

Step 2: Enter Blog Post Details

Title: Enter a blog title (e.g., "Top 10 Trends of 2025").
Content: Add text, images, videos, or embedded content.
Author: Select or create an author name.
Featured Image: Upload a thumbnail image for the blog post.
Visibility: Choose Visible to publish immediately or Hidden to save as a draft.

Step 3: Assign the Blog to a Category

Scroll to Organization and select a blog category.
Default is "News" (Create a new blog category if needed).


Click Manage Blogs to create and organize multiple blog categories.

Step 4: Customize SEO Settings (Optional)

Click Edit Website SEO.
Add a meta title, meta description, and URL handle to improve search visibility.

Step 5: Save & Publish

Click Save to store changes.
If ready, ensure the post is Visible and published on your store.

Step 6: Add the Blog to Navigation (Optional)

Go to Shopify Admin > Online Store > Navigation.
Click Main Menu or Footer Menu.
Click Add Menu Item, enter "Blog", and select your blog page.
Click Save Menu to make it accessible on your store.

Best Practices

Use engaging titles to attract readers.
Include high-quality images to make content visually appealing.
Optimize blog posts with SEO-friendly keywords.
Share blog posts on social media to increase traffic.

collections/collections.html.title: Collections
collections/collections.html.body:
Collections
Collections in Shopify allow you to group products into categories or themes, making it easier for customers to browse your store and find related items.
For example, you can create collections like "Summer Clothing," "Best Sellers," or "On Sale.
Types of Collections in Shopify 
Manual Collections:

A Manual Collection requires you to individually add products to the collection.
It gives full control over which products appear.


TIP: 

Go to Shopify Admin > Products > Collections.
Click Create Collection.
Enter a Title and Description.
Under Collection Type, select Manual.
Click Save and then manually add products.


Best Use Cases:

Seasonal or Limited-Time Collections (e.g., Holiday Specials).
Curated Product Lists (e.g., Staff Picks, Best Sellers).
Exclusive or VIP Products that require manual selection.

Automated Collections:

An Automated Collection uses rules and conditions to dynamically add products.
Products that match the set conditions are automatically included in the collection.


TIP: 

Go to Shopify Admin > Products > Collections.
Click Create Collection.
Enter a Title and Description.
Under Collection Type, select Automated.
Set the Conditions (e.g., Product Tag = "New Arrival").
Click Save and products that match the rules will be added automatically.


Best Use Cases:

New Arrivals (Automatically add new products).
Sale Items (Include products based on price discounts).
Product Type-Based Collections (e.g., All T-Shirts, Accessories).



Steps for Creating Automated Collections 

Set Conditions:
Examples:
Product tag is "Summer."
Price is greater than $50.
Vendor is "Nike."




Match Conditions:
Decide if products must match all conditions or any condition.


Automatic Addition:
Products meeting the set conditions will be added to the collection automatically.






TIP: 
Note: Ensure products are created and assigned to collections before setting them up.

Comparison: Manual vs. Automated Collections



Feature
Manual Collection
Automated Collection




Product Selection
Manually added by store owner
Added automatically based on rules


Maintenance Effort
High (requires manual updates)
Low (updates dynamically)


Best For
Curated collections, limited-time offers
Large catalogs, automatic organization


Example Use Case
"Staff Picks" collection
"Under $50" collection

filters/filters.html.title: Filters
filters/filters.html.body:
Filters
Shopify’s product filters help customers refine their search on collection pages or search results pages. Filters are typically displayed as a sidebar, dropdown menu, or drawer to improve navigation and shopping experience
Built-in Shopify Filters

Availability: In stock / Out of stock
Price: Allows filtering based on price range
Product Type: Sort products by category (e.g., Shirts, Pants, Jackets)
Vendor (Brand): Filters products by brand or manufacturer




Common Filter Types



Filter Type
Description




Price Filter
Customers can filter products based on price range (e.g., $0-$50, $50-$100).


Size Filter
Displays available sizes (e.g., Small, Medium, Large).


Color Filter
Filters products by color options.


Category/Type Filter
Organizes products by category (e.g., Jackets, Shoes).


Brand Filter
Allows filtering by specific brands or manufacturers.


Material Filter
Filters based on product materials (e.g., Cotton, Leather).


Custom Filters
Includes unique filters like occasion, style, or features (e.g., waterproof, eco-friendly).



Types of Filter Layouts

Vertical Filter Layout – Traditional sidebar filter layout.
Drawer Filter Layout – Filters appear in a collapsible drawer (default for mobile).
Pagination Style – Choose between load more or numbered pages.
List View – Allows customers to switch between grid view and list view.

How to Add Search & Discovery App in Shopify
Step 1: Install the App

Go to Shopify Admin > Apps.
Click Visit the Shopify App Store.
Search for Search & Discovery and select the official Shopify app.
Click Add App and confirm installation.

Step 2: Configure Filters

Open Shopify Admin > Apps > Search & Discovery.
Navigate to Filters and click Manage Filters.
Click Add Filter and choose from options like Price, Size, Brand, Material, etc.
Click Save to apply the filters.



Step 3: Test on Your Store

Go to a Collection Page or Search Results Page.
Check if the filters appear and function correctly.

getting-started/theme-license.html.body:
Theme license
Understanding Theme Licensing for Elegance
Please ensure you have a valid license to use the Elegancetheme.
Key Points About Theme Licensing

Your version of Elegance must be purchased directly from the Shopify Theme Store.
Each store you operate must have a separate license to use the Elegance theme.
The Shopify Theme Store is the only legitimate source for purchasing themes that comply with Shopify’s terms.

Invalid Purchase Sources

Shopify does not recognize themes purchased from Fiverr, eBay, Etsy, Creative Market, Template Monster, or development agencies as valid.
To ensure support and compliance, always buy themes from the official Shopify Theme Store.

Benefits of a Valid License
Purchasing a valid theme license provides several benefits, including:

Free Technical Support – Our support team is available to help you maximize the theme’s features and assist with using Elegance.
Free Theme Updates – Receive continuous improvements and new features at no additional cost.
Store Compliance & Security – A licensed theme ensures your store remains compliant with Shopify’s policies while benefiting from ongoing enhancements and security updates.

Setting Up After Purchase

After purchasing a theme, you can continue using your current version without needing to reconfigure your store.
If you choose to update to the latest version, standard setup procedures apply, just like any new theme installation.

Privacy and your information 

Invisible Themes respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information. Any information collected through our compliance processes is used solely for enforcing and managing theme licenses and will not be publicly disclosed.

Product Variants
Product Variants allow you to offer different options for a single product, such as size, color, material, or style. This feature helps streamline your product catalog and provides customers with more choices. Below is a guide to creating and managing product variants in Shopify.

TIP: 
Note : Variants are based on options, which are characteristics of the product (e.g., size, color). Each product can have up to 3 options (e.g., Size, Color, Material).

Add Variants to a Product
Step 1: Add Variants to a Product

Go to Shopify Admin > Products.
Select an existing product or create a new one.
Scroll down to the Variants section.
Enable This product has multiple options (e.g., size, color).



Step 2: Configure Variant Options

Option Name: Enter the type of option (e.g., Size, Color).
Option Values: Add the available choices (e.g., Small, Medium, Large or Red, Blue, Green).
Click Add another option if you need more than one variant type (e.g., Size and Color).

Step 3: Customize Variant Details
For each variant, you can specify:

Price: Set a unique price for the variant (if different from the base product).
SKU: Add a unique stock-keeping unit for inventory tracking.
Barcode: Enter a barcode for the variant (if applicable).
Inventory: Manage stock levels for each variant.
Weight: Add the variant’s weight for shipping calculations.

Step 4: Add Media for Variants

Upload images or videos for each variant (e.g., a red shirt image for the “Red” color variant).
Assign media to the corresponding variant in the Media section.

Step 5: Save and Preview

Click Save to apply the changes.
Preview the product on your storefront to ensure variants display correctly.

Managing Variants
Bulk Editing Variants

Go to Shopify Admin > Products.
Select a product with variants.
Click Edit Variants to update multiple variants at once (e.g., adjust prices or inventory).

Deleting Variants

In the Variants section, click the trash icon next to the variant you want to remove.
Confirm the deletion.

sections/slideshow.html.title: Slideshow
sections/slideshow.html.body:
Slideshow
The Slideshow Section is a dynamic content area that allows you to display multiple images or banners in a sliding format. It is perfect for highlighting promotions, featured products, or key messages.

TIP: 

Go to Shopify Admin > Online Store > Themes.
Click Customize on your live theme.
In the theme editor, click Add Section > Slideshow.




Slideshow Section


Slideshow

Carousel Settings

Effect
Slide – Slides transition in a sliding motion.
Fade – Slides transition with a fading effect.


Loop – Enable to continuously cycle through slides.
Change Slides Every
Set the delay between transitions in seconds.

The Testimonials Section allows you to showcase customer reviews, feedback, or endorsements, building trust and credibility with potential buyers.

sections/text-with-icons.html.title: Text With Icons
sections/text-with-icons.html.body:
Text with Icons
The Text with Icons section allows you to display important information using visual icons alongside text. This is ideal for highlighting product features, benefits, shipping policies, guarantees, or any key details in a structured and attractive format.

TIP: 

Go to Shopify Admin > Online Store > Themes.
Click Customize on your active theme.
In the theme editor, click Add Section > Text with Icons.
Customize the section by:
Selecting icons (e.g., shipping, support, warranty).
Adding headings & descriptions.
Adjusting layout and colors to match your store’s branding.






Settings & Customization


Layout

Expand to Full Width: Enable this option to extend the section across the entire screen width.

Background Opacity: Set the transparency level (Range: 0–100, Default: 100).\
\&#xNAN;This setting applies to the background image, which can be customized in the theme settings.

Heading: Set a custom title (e.g., "Our Features").

Subheading: Add additional text if needed.

Desktop Content Alignment: Choose the text alignment for desktop (Left, Center, or Right).\
\&#xNAN;The content alignment is automatically centered on mobile screens.

Color Scheme: Select a predefined scheme for text and background colors.

Border Style: Apply a border effect to the block (Options: None, Full border, Vertical border).

Icon Settings

Shaper: Add visual elements (None, Shaper Top, Shaper Bottom, Both, Borders).

Text with Icons > Add Text with Icons

sections/video-section.html.title: Video Section

template-blog.html.title: Template Blog
template-blog.html.summary: This section shows lists of the blogs published on your website.
template-blog.html.body:
Template- Blog
Blog Template is used to design and structure your blog listing page — where all your blog articles (posts) under a specific blog name (like "News" or "Journal") are displayed.

TIP: 

Go to Online Store > Themes > Customize
At the top dropdown, choose Blogs > Default Blog
You’ll now be editing the blog listing template, not individual articles




Blog

Expand to Full Width: Enable this option to extend the collections section across the entire screen width for a full-bleed layout.
Color Scheme: Customize the section’s appearance using preset text and background color options.
Background Opacity: Set the transparency level of the background image (Range: 0–100, Default: 100). This setting applies to the background image configured in the theme settings.
Heading Size: Choose the heading size – Small, Medium, or Large (Default: Large).
Desktop Content Alignment: Align the heading and subheading to the Left, Center, or Right. On mobile screens, content is automatically centered.

Content Settings

Number of Posts to Show: Set the total number of blog posts to display in this section.
Desktop Columns: Choose the number of columns on desktop devices. (Options: 2, 3, or 4)\

Cart

\&#xNAN;This encourages customers to add more items to qualify for shipping benefits.

Drawer: Opens as a side panel overlay, allowing customers to continue browsing without leaving the page.
Page: Redirects to a full cart page with detailed information.

template/template-product.html.title: Template Product
template/template-product.html.summary: This section is to maintain the settings of the product page on your store.
template/template-product.html.body:
Template product
The Main Product section in Shopify is where you configure how a product appears on the product detail page (PDP). It controls everything from product title and price to images, buttons, and more.

TIP: 

Go to Online Store > Themes > Customize
In the theme editor, click the top dropdown menu
Select Products > Default Product
On the left side panel, click on Main Product




Settings & Customization


Layout

Expand to Full Width: Enable this option to extend the section across the entire screen width.
Color scheme: You can customize the section’s appearance by changing the text color, background color, and more using preset color options.
Enable Sticky on Desktop: Keep the product information panel visible as users scroll down the page on desktop devices for better accessibility.
Desktop Media Placement : Left / Right: Choose whether the product media (images/videos) should appear on the left or right side of the screen on desktop.

Toggle Close Icon: Upload a custom icon to represent the "closed" state.

theme-settings/border-and-shadow.html.title: Border And Shadow
theme-settings/border-and-shadow.html.body:
Border and Shadow
The Border and Shadow settings in Shopify allow you to customize the appearance of elements like product cards, buttons, sections, and images by adding borders, rounded corners, and shadow effects. These settings help enhance the design and user experience of your store.

TIP: 

Go to Shopify Admin > Online Store > Themes.
Click Customize on your active theme.
In the Theme Editor, click Theme Settings >Border and Shadow




Customization Options:
Border

Border: Applies to media elements and content blocks across the theme.
Thickness: Set the thickness of the border.
Corner Radius: Define how rounded the corners appear.

Shadow

Shadow: Applies specifically to headings for added depth or emphasis.
Shadow Thickness: Control the intensity of the shadow effect.

Text Stroke

Text Stroke: Outlines headings or large text for visual impact.
Stroke Opacity: Controls the transparency of the stroke.

theme-settings/brand-information.html.title: Brand Information
theme-settings/brand-information.html.body:
Brand Information
The Brand Information section in Shopify allows you to showcase your store's branding, including your brand name, logo, description, colors, and social media links. This helps customers recognize and trust your brand.

TIP: 

Go to Shopify Admin > Online Store > Themes.
Click Customize on your active theme.
In the Theme Editor, click Theme Settings > Brand Information




Brand Description

Headline: Set a custom heading for the brand section in the footer. (Example: header)
Description: Add a brief brand introduction or tagline.
Example: "Our products, ranging from bright highlighters to bold lip colors and everything in between, are made to accentuate your inherent beauty."



Brand Image

Upload Image: Add a brand-related image to enhance the section.
Image Width: Adjust the display size of the image. (Default: 550px)

theme-settings/button.html.title: Button
theme-settings/button.html.body:
Button
Buttons are essential elements in your Shopify store, guiding users to add products to the cart, checkout, or explore more pages. Shopify allows you to customize buttons to match your branding and improve user engagement.

TIP: 

Go to Shopify Admin > Online Store > Themes.
Click Customize on your active theme.
In the Theme Editor, click Theme Settings > Button




Border

Thickness: Defines the border thickness for buttons. (Default: 2px)
Button Shape: Select the button style. (Options: Classic, Modern and Default )

Shadow

Shadow Application: Applies shadows to buttons and input fields.
Horizontal Offset: Adjusts the shadow position on the X-axis. (Default: 1px)
Vertical Offset: Adjusts the shadow position on the Y-axis. (Default: 2px)
Shadow Thickness: Defines the intensity of the shadow. (Default: 0px)
Text Stroke: Sets the thickness of the text outline. (Default: 0px)
Stroke Opacity: Controls the transparency of the text stroke. (Default: 0%)

Input Settings

Thickness: Defines the border thickness for input fields. (Default: 2px)
Corner Radius: Adjusts the roundness of input field corners. (Default: 15px)

theme-settings/cards.html.title: Cards
theme-settings/cards.html.body:
Cards
Cards in Shopify are used to display products, collections, blog posts, or promotions in a structured layout. They typically include an image, title, price, description, and buttons (e.g., "Add to Cart" or "View More").

TIP: 

Go to Shopify Admin > Online Store > Themes.
Click Customize on your active theme.
In the Theme Editor, click Theme Settings > Cards




Product Card

Color scheme : You can customize the theme appearance by changing the text color, background color, and more using preset color options.
Background Opacity: Controls the transparency of the product card's background. (Range: 0–100, Default: 0)

Collection Card

Color scheme : You can customize the theme appearance by changing the text color, background color, and more using preset color options.
Background Opacity: Controls the transparency of the collection card's background. (Range: 0–100, Default: 100)

Blog Card

Color scheme : You can customize the theme appearance by changing the text color, background color, and more using preset color options.
Background Opacity: Controls the transparency of the blog card's background. (Range: 0–100, Default: 0)

theme-settings/cart.html.title: Cart
theme-settings/cart.html.body:
Cart
The Cart in Shopify is where customers review their selected products before proceeding to checkout. You can customize the cart page, drawer cart (side cart), cart icon, and cart behavior to improve the shopping experience.

TIP: 

Go to Shopify Admin > Online Store > Themes.
Click Customize on your active theme.
In the Theme Editor, click Theme Settings > Social Icons.




Cart Type

Drawer: Opens the cart in a side panel without leaving the page.
Page: Redirects customers to a separate cart page.

Cart Note

Allows customers to add special instructions or notes to their order.

Free Shipping Bar

Enable: Activates the free shipping progress bar.
Minimum Amount: Sets the order value required for free shipping. (Default: 500)
Customers must reach this amount in their cart to qualify.

theme-settings/color-swatches.html.title: Color Swatches
theme-settings/color-swatches.html.body:
Color Swatches
The Color Swatches settings allow you to customize the appearance of color-based filters in collections and search. These settings help customers easily identify and select products based on color options.

TIP: 

Go to Shopify Admin > Online Store > Themes.
Click Customize on your active theme.
In the Theme Editor, click Theme Settings > Color Swatches.




Swatch Display Options

Option Name to Show as Swatch: Defines which variant options are displayed as color swatches. (Default: color,couleur,farbe)
If your store supports multiple languages, enter translations separated by commas (e.g., color,couleur,farbe).
The variant option named "Color" is automatically converted into swatches.



Swatch Shape

Rounded: Displays swatches with rounded edges.
Boxed: Displays swatches as square or rectangular boxes.

theme-settings/colors.html.title: Colors
theme-settings/colors.html.body:
Colors
Color Schemes in your theme settings allow you to create and apply a consistent visual identity across various sections of your online store. These schemes ensure that the color palette used in your site aligns with your brand identity and enhances the user experience.

TIP: 

Go to Shopify Admin > Online Store > Themes.
Click Customize on your active theme.
In the Theme Editor, click Theme Settings > Color from the left panel.


Color scheme : You can customize the theme appearance by changing the text color, background color, and more using preset color options.

theme-settings/currency-codes.html.title: Currency Codes
theme-settings/currency-codes.html.body:
Currency Codes
Currency Codes refer to the three-letter codes used to represent different currencies (e.g., USD for US Dollar, EUR for Euro, GBP for British Pound). These codes help display product prices in different currencies for international customers.

TIP: 

Go to Shopify Admin > Online Store > Themes.
Click Customize on your active theme.
In the Theme Editor, click Theme Settings > Currency Codes.




Currency Codes

Cart and Checkout Prices – Prices displayed in the cart and during checkout will always include currency codes. (Example: $1.00 USD )
Show Currency Codes – Enable this option to display the currency code alongside product prices throughout the store.

Enabling Multi-Currency (For Shopify Payments Users)
If you want to allow customers to shop in multiple currencies:

Go to Shopify Admin > Settings > Payments.
Click Shopify Payments > Manage.
Scroll down to Currencies and select the ones you want to support.
Click Save.

theme-settings/custom-css.html.title: Custom Css
theme-settings/custom-css.html.body:
Custom CSS
The Custom CSS option in Shopify's Theme Settings allows you to modify the default styles of your theme, providing greater flexibility in personalizing your store’s appearance.

TIP: 

Go to Shopify Admin > Online Store > Themes.
Click Customize on your active theme.
In the Theme Editor, click Theme Settings > Custom CSS.
Add your CSS code in the provided entry form.
Click Save to apply your changes.


By adding valid CSS entries, you can customize layouts, typography, colors, spacing, and other design elements

theme-settings/general-settings.html.title: General Settings
theme-settings/general-settings.html.body:
General Settings
The Theme Settings section in Shopify allows you to fully customize the design and functionality of your store.

TIP: 

Go to Shopify Admin > Online Store > Themes.
Click Customize on your active theme.
In the Theme Editor, click Theme Settings > Typography .


General Settings


Layout : Adjust overall page structure.

Page Width: Set the maximum width of the content container.
Card Style: Choose the display style for product, collection, and blog cards:
Classic – Traditional bordered layout.
Modern – Sleek and minimal card design.


Display Scroll to Top: Enable a floating button that lets users quickly scroll to the top of the page.
Animation Effect : Choose the animation style for theme content appearance: Fade, Fade Up, Fade Down, or None.

Background Settings : Apply a custom background across the store.

Background Image: Set a background image that applies site-wide.
Pattern Image: Upload an optional overlay image to apply a pattern over the background.
Pattern Color: Define the overlay color for the pattern.

theme-settings/logo.html.title: Logo
theme-settings/logo.html.body:
Logo
Logo and Favicon settings under Theme Settings allow you to upload and customize your store’s logo (for your header and footer) and favicon (the small icon shown in browser tabs).

TIP: 

Go to Shopify Admin > Online Store > Themes.
Click Customize on your active theme.
In the Theme Editor, click Theme Settings > Logo from the left panel.




Logo Settings

Upload Logo – Add a custom logo for your website. Supported file formats: PNG, JPG, SVG.
Desktop Logo Width – Set the width of the logo (Default: 180px).
Note: The logo width is automatically optimized for mobile devices.

Favicon Settings

Upload Favicon – Add a favicon image to be displayed in the browser tab.
Favicon Size – The uploaded image will be scaled down to 32 × 32px for optimal display.
Upload Logo: Click Upload Image and add your logo.
Adjust Logo Width: Look for the Logo width setting and adjust it (in pixels or percentage).

theme-settings/offcanvas-drawer.html.title: Offcanvas Drawer
theme-settings/offcanvas-drawer.html.body:
Offcanvas Drawer
The Offcanvas Drawer is a hidden sliding panel used for displaying the menu, cart, or search options in a sleek, unobtrusive way. You can customize the style, color scheme, and separator style for the drawer to match your store's theme and enhance the user experience.

TIP: 

Go to Shopify Admin > Online Store > Themes.
Click Customize on your active theme.
In the Theme Editor, click Theme Settings.
Select Offcanvas Drawer to customize the settings.




This color scheme will be applied to the cart drawer, canvas, and quick view, ensuring visual consistency across these elements.
Color scheme : You can customize the theme appearance by changing the text color, background color, and more using preset color options.

theme-settings/search-behaviour.html.title: Search Behaviour
theme-settings/search-behaviour.html.body:
Search behaviour
Shopify’s search functionality helps customers quickly find products, collections, and pages. You can customize search settings to improve results, add filters, enable predictive search, and enhance the search experience.

TIP: 

Go to Shopify Admin > Online Store > Themes.
Click Customize on your active theme.
In the Theme Editor, click Theme Settings > Search behaviour




This setting customizes the search drawer’s design and functionality.
Appearance

Color scheme : You can customize the theme appearance by changing the text color, background color, and more using preset color options.
Search Card Color: Sets the color scheme for search result cards.

Search Result Display Options
Enable or disable the following elements in search results:

Show Price – Display product prices in search results.
Show Pages – Include store pages in search results.
Show Articles – Display blog articles in search results.
Show Collections – Include product collections in search results.
Show Products – Display individual products in search results.

theme-settings/social-icon.html.title: Social Icon
theme-settings/social-icon.html.body:
Social Icon
The Social Media Settings allow you to add social icons and links to your store, making it easy for customers to connect with your brand on various platforms.

TIP: 

Go to Shopify Admin > Online Store > Themes.
Click Customize on your active theme.
In the Theme Editor, click Theme Settings > Social Icons.
Enter your social media links in the provided fields.
Click Save to apply your changes.


Settings & Customization


Social Icons

Enable social media icons to display in the header, footer, or other sections of your store.
Icons automatically link to the accounts you set up.

Supported Platforms

Facebook
Instagram
Twitter (X)
Pinterest
YouTube
LinkedIn
TikTok

Adding Social Links

Enter the full URL of each social media profile to link it to the corresponding icon.
Example: https://www.instagram.com/yourbrand

Best Practices

Use consistent branding across all social platforms.
Place icons in visible areas like the header or footer for easy access.
Regularly update social links to ensure they are active and correct.

theme-settings/typography.html.title: Typography
theme-settings/typography.html.body:
Typography
With the Typography settings, you have the freedom to personalize the font styles, sizes, and letter casing for your entire store.

TIP: 

Go to Shopify Admin > Online Store > Themes.
Click Customize on your active theme.
In the Theme Editor, click Theme Settings > Typography .




Headings

Configure the font type and size for all headings used in the theme.
Choose from available font styles to match your brand identity.

Body Text

The theme primarily uses the body font as the main font type.
Customize the font type and size to ensure readability and consistency across your store.

toggle-content.html.title: Toggle Content
toggle-content.html.body:
Toggle content
Toggle Content a collapsible section that expands or hides content when clicked—ideal for FAQs, product details, or policies.

TIP: 

Go to Shopify Admin > Online Store > Themes.
Click Customize on your active theme.
In the Theme Editor, click Add Section >Toggle content




Settings & Customization


Layout 

Expand to Full Width: Enable this option to extend the section across the entire screen width.
Color scheme: You can customize the section’s appearance by changing the text color, background color, and more using preset color options.
Background Opacity: Set the transparency level (Range: 0–100, Default: 100). This applies to the background image, which can be customized in the theme settings.

Content Settings

Heading: Set a custom title (e.g., "We’re are featured by").
Heading Size: Choose from Small, Medium, or Large (Default: Large).
Text: Add optional supporting text.
Text Position:
Above Main Heading – Position the text above the heading.
Below Main Heading – Position the text below the heading (Default).


Desktop Content Alignment: Choose from Left, Right, or Center (Automatically centered on mobile screens).

Image Settings

Upload Image: Select an image using the "Upload" or "Explore free images" option.
Image Height: Set the banner height to Adapt, Small, Medium, or Large (Default: Adapt).
Desktop Image Placement: Options: Image First and Image second (default for mobile layout).
Collapsible Row Behavior: Enable Open First Collapsible Row to expand the first row by default.

Section padding 

Top & Bottom Padding: Adjust the spacing above and below the section for a well-structured layout.

Shapes 

Shaper – Adds shape effects to the section. Options: Shaper Top, Shaper Bottom, Shaper Both, None, Border Top, Border Bottom, and Both Borders.
Shaper Top Color – Sets the top shape color (choose your preferred color).
Shaper Bottom Color – Sets the bottom shape color (choose your preferred color).
